display_information.name: Bkper
display_information.description: Ask about your Bkper Books and Apps, right in Slack.
display_information.long_description:
Ask about your Bkper Books, and work on your Bkper Apps, without leaving Slack.

Tag @bkper in a thread, or message it directly, and Bkper Agent answers right there, as you: with your own Bkper account, your access to Books and the Apps you develop.

With your Books
• Ask about balances, expenses, invoices and results: "what is the cash balance in Acme Corp today?"
• Drop a receipt or a bank statement and say "record this"
• Ask for a report or an export, and the file is posted in the thread
• Ask for a dashboard or a visual explanation, and it opens in its own channel as a page

With your Apps
• Ask it to change a Bkper App you develop, and it opens a dedicated channel for the work
• It changes, builds and pushes the code, with the diff shown for review
• Everyone in the channel works on the same branch, each as themselves
• It deploys only after you confirm

Everyone acts as themselves
• Each person connects their own Bkper account once. Every answer opens with whose access it uses.
• Bkper enforces each person's Book sharing and App permissions on every read and every change
• It asks before changing anything, and only the person who asked can confirm. Book history shows the change as theirs, via Bkper for Slack.
• In a thread, reply without tagging it while it is talking with you

Good to know
• In a channel, everyone there sees the answers. For anything private, message it directly.
• Slack never sees your Bkper credentials
• Usage counts against the Bkper AI allowance of the person who asked
• Disconnect any time from the Home tab, or uninstall to remove everyone's connections

agent_view.agent_description: Answers questions about your Bkper Books and works on them, and on the Bkper Apps you develop: acts as each person, with their own Bkper account.
